newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy firms, corn and wheat steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy firms, corn and wheat steady.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean basis values firmed one to two cents a bushel on Wednesday pressed by lower CBOT soybean prices while corn and wheat basis prices were generally steady, dealers said.
Soybeans slipped because the CBOT board was down, a dealer said. FOB corn prices were steady amid quiet export activity and lack of interest, another exporter said.
On the export front, Morocco was seeking 50,000 tonnes of optional soft wheat, European grain exporters said.
No other details were available but one U.S. broker said he believed the shipment date was for June/July.
